title: pasta: intermittent connection reset (latest vs 2025_12_23 build)
body:
### Issue Description

Running `netperf -t TCP_CRR` from a rootless podman container with `pasta` network and using address (`host.containers.internal`) intermittently fails with `Connection reset by peer` on a recent pasta build. The same test does not fail on an older pasta build.

pasta versions involved:
- Failing: `pasta 2026_07_28.f8df3f1-2-g7e8d49b` or any latest `2026_*`
- Not failing (older): `pasta 2025_12_23.2ba9fd5`

### Steps to reproduce the issue

1. On the host: `sudo netserver -D -d`
2. `podman run -it --rm <image with netperf installed> bash`
3. Inside the container: `netperf -H host.containers.internal -t TCP_CRR -p 12865 -l 5`
4. Repeat step 3 several times in a row.

### Describe the results you received

- Reproduce issue using latest pasta version from https://passt.top/passt/tree/
```
$ pasta --version
pasta 2026_07_28.f8df3f1-2-g7e8d49b
Copyright Red Hat
GNU General Public License, version 2 or later
  <https://www.gnu.org/licenses/old-licenses/gpl-2.0.html>
This is free software: you are free to change and redistribute it.
There is NO WARRANTY, to the extent permitted by law.
```

- Container-to-Host using "host.containers.internal"
  - netperf(client) inside container -> netserver(server) on host
- We can see frequent "Connection reset by peer"
- new pasta `(2026_07_28.f8df3f1-2-g7e8d49b)`: 38 resets out of 100 runs.
- Below is a snippet
```bash
MIGRATED TCP Connect/Request/Response TEST from 0.0.0.0 (0.0.0.0) port 0 AF_INET to host.containers.internal () port 0 AF_INET : demo
Connection reset by peer
netperf: remote error 104
```
